description: Phase precedence: a configured redirect (phase 6) fires BEFORE the synthetic --single rewrite (phase 7). Per openspec/specs/routing/spec.md SRV-ROUT-006, redirects are evaluated before rewrites. With redirect /old → /new and --single set, GET /old must 301 to /new (NOT 200 with /index.html body via the SPA catch-all). Anchor: `redirect_wins_over_single`. cleanUrls is disabled to keep the test focused on the redirect-vs-rewrite ordering.
